tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search current property listings in Northern Cyprus. All filters are optional and accept English, Russian or Turkish spellings (e.g. region 'Kyrenia' or 'Гирне'). Returns up to `limit` listings (featured first, then newest by default) with a one-line `summary`, `url` and `contact_url`. Example: long

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full details of one listing by id (e.g. 'c-152' or 'b-7'): full description, photos, dates. If `latest_id` is set, this is an older copy of a reposted listing — use the newest one instead.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: Regions and areas of Northern Cyprus with the number of current listings (rent and sale), names in English and Russian. Use to pick `region` / `sub_region` for search_listings.
